//! MODUL 1/3 - "komponen": the UI tree recorded from the FigCraft design.
//! Generated by `figcraft-rust-export`. Values can be inserted at runtime with
//! `Component::set`; every `{{key}}` in a text layer is looked up there.

use crate::caller::Value;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Rgba {
    pub r: u8,
    pub g: u8,
    pub b: u8,
    pub a: u8,
}

impl Rgba {
    pub const fn new(r: u8, g: u8, b: u8, a: u8) -> Self {
        Self { r, g, b, a }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct Rect {
    pub x: f32,
    pub y: f32,
    pub width: f32,
    pub height: f32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Align {
    #[default]
    Start,
    Center,
    End,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Axis {
    #[default]
    Vertical,
    Horizontal,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct Style {
    pub fill: Option<Rgba>,
    pub stroke: Option<Rgba>,
    pub stroke_width: f32,
    pub radius: f32,
    pub opacity: f32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Kind {
    Frame { layout: Option<Axis>, gap: f32, padding: f32 },
    Rectangle,
    Ellipse,
    Line { x2: f32, y2: f32 },
    Text { text: String, font_size: f32, bold: bool, color: Rgba, align: Align },
    Image { path: String },
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct Node {
    pub id: u64,
    pub name: String,
    pub rect: Rect,
    pub style: Style,
    pub kind: Kind,
    pub visible: bool,
    pub children: Vec<Node>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct Component {
    pub name: String,
    pub width: f32,
    pub height: f32,
    /// Runtime values, e.g. `set("title", Value::Text("Hello".into()))`.
    pub values: BTreeMap<String, Value>,
    pub root: Vec<Node>,
}

impl Component {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self::default()
    }

    /// Insert a value used by `{{key}}` placeholders in text layers.
    pub fn set(&mut self, key: impl Into<String>, value: Value) -> &mut Self {
        self.values.insert(key.into(), value);
        self
    }

    pub fn value(&self, key: &str) -> Option<&Value> {
        self.values.get(key)
    }

    /// Replace every `{{key}}` with its value (missing keys stay as written).
    pub fn resolve(&self, text: &str) -> String {
        self.resolve_with(text, &BTreeMap::new())
    }

    /// Like [`resolve`], but lets the caller override the component's values.
    pub fn resolve_with(&self, text: &str, overrides: &BTreeMap<String, Value>) -> String {
        let mut out = String::with_capacity(text.len());
        let mut rest = text;
        while let Some(start) = rest.find("{{") {
            out.push_str(&rest[..start]);
            let after = &rest[start + 2..];
            match after.find("}}") {
                Some(end) => {
                    let key = &after[..end];
                    match overrides.get(key).or_else(|| self.values.get(key)) {
                        Some(Value::Text(v)) => out.push_str(v),
                        Some(Value::Number(v)) => out.push_str(&v.to_string()),
                        Some(Value::Flag(v)) => out.push_str(if *v { "true" } else { "false" }),
                        Some(Value::Color(v)) => out.push_str(&format!("#{:02X}{:02X}{:02X}", v.r, v.g, v.b)),
                        None => out.push_str(&rest[start..start + end + 4]),
                    }
                    rest = &after[end + 2..];
                }
                None => {
                    out.push_str(&rest[start..]);
                    return out;
                }
            }
        }
        out.push_str(rest);
        out
    }

    /// Find a layer by its FigCraft id.
    pub fn node(&self, id: u64) -> Option<&Node> {
        fn find<'a>(nodes: &'a [Node], id: u64) -> Option<&'a Node> {
            for node in nodes {
                if node.id == id {
                    return Some(node);
                }
                if let Some(found) = find(&node.children, id) {
                    return Some(found);
                }
            }
            None
        }
        find(&self.root, id)
    }
}
